name: CanopyVault
tagline: Audit-ready compliance for every licensed operator, on every shift.
positioning: CanopyVault turns state seed-to-sale rules into automated checks, so SMB dispensaries and cultivators pass inspections without a compliance manager.

hero.h1: Compliance that closes the shift, not the store.
hero.sub: CanopyVault watches every Metrc sync, manifest, and limit in real time — flagging violations before your state regulator ever emails you.

features.title: Metrc sync guardrails
features.description: Every package tag, transfer, and adjustment is validated against state rules the moment it hits Metrc — errors caught before they become citations.

features.title: Purchase-limit enforcement
features.description: Block over-limit sales at the register with real-time equivalency math, so budtenders never guess a customer's daily flower cap again.

features.title: Inspection binder, on demand
features.description: Generate a timestamped, regulator-ready audit binder — SOPs, manifests, and destruction logs — in one export before the inspector reaches the counter.

features.title: License & renewal calendar
features.description: Track every license, permit, and badge expiry across locations with escalating reminders so nothing lapses mid-quarter.

features.title: Waste & destruction logs
features.description: Guided disposal workflows with quarantine timers and witness sign-off keep your waste manifests defensible for three years.

features.title: Multi-state rule engine
features.description: One dashboard, many rulebooks. CanopyVault maps each location to its state's current regulations and updates when the rules change.

testimonials.quote: Our last state inspection took nineteen minutes. The inspector asked for our destruction logs and I exported the binder before she finished the sentence. CanopyVault paid for itself that morning.
testimonials.name: Dana Ruiz

testimonials.quote: We run two dispensaries with no full-time compliance hire. The purchase-limit blocks at the register alone have stopped four over-sales this month that would've been reportable.
testimonials.name: Marcus Feld

testimonials.quote: Metrc used to be where our reconciliation errors went to hide. Now every discrepancy pings the assistant manager on shift. Our variance report is finally clean.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand
